label: Armor
description: Named helmets, torso and limb armor, shields, full suits, modern protective gear, and fantasy armor.
notes: Protective pieces, shields, and complete armor ensembles belong here; object.weapon owns offensive weapons and fighting implements. Values are complete noun phrases with articles where needed, and paired limb pieces use a pair of. Historical armor remains usable as contemporary costume, replica, or display armor without era restrictions. Only visibly speculative suits have genre tags; a crested Corinthian helmet covers the familiar Spartan-style look without a duplicate entry.
